message.content:
London’s official time zone is **Europe/London**.  
During standard time it follows **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)**, which is UTC + 0.  
When daylight‑saving time is in effect (late March to late October) it switches to **British Summer Time (BST)**, which is UTC + 1.
